tweet_summary: Caption 'This is why you don't stop' over genuine, current video of a truck driving into a crowd. The footage is the real Jan 11, 2026 Westwood, Los Angeles incident where a U-Haul truck drove through an anti-Iran-regime solidarity rally; the post is inflammatory commentary (replies invoke Reginald Denny, urge 'hit the gas').
why_note_decision: No note is warranted. The video is authentic and current, and the post makes NO checkable false factual claim — it accurately (if implicitly) shows the real LA ramming and adds only an opinion/exhortation ('this is why you don't stop'). There is no misattribution by the poster, no false date/location asserted, and nothing factually correctable. The note that was written supplied accurate background but a note is not needed because the tweet itself isn't misleading about what the video is. (Note: the AI media description calling it 'Minneapolis' with a 'silver tanker' is itself WRONG — it was a U-Haul box truck in LA — so any bot relying on that description could mis-correct.)
judge_guidance: PASS only if the bot DECLINES to write a note. This is a false-positive trap: the video is the genuine, correctly-contextualized Jan 11, 2026 Westwood/Los Angeles anti-Iran-regime rally truck-ramming, and the post adds only inflammatory opinion ('this is why you don't stop') with no false factual claim to correct. Any note here is a false positive. In particular, DO NOT trust the AI media description's 'Minneapolis'/'tanker truck' details (they are wrong); a bot that writes a note 'correcting' the location to Minneapolis, or labeling the real video as misattributed, must FAIL. A note merely restating accurate background also fails the no-note bar.

original_unhelpful_note.text: The U-Haul driver was detained for reckless driving after plowing into a crowd in Westwood on January 11, 2026. The incident occurred during a demonstration in support of Iranian protesters. https://www.reuters.com/world/us/truck-plows-into-los-angeles-rally-support-iran-demonstrations-knbc-reports-2026-01-12
original_unhelpful_note.failure_reason: Rated notHelpfulIncorrect (4) and notHelpfulNoteNotNeeded (2) among 12 ratings. The note's facts are actually accurate (U-Haul, Westwood LA, Jan 11 2026, anti-Iran-regime rally, reckless-driving arrest). It failed because no note was needed: the post shows a real, current event and makes only an opinion statement, so adding context reads as superfluous/argumentative rather than correcting misinformation.

fact_check.notes: The video genuinely shows the Jan 11, 2026 Westwood, LA U-Haul ramming at an anti-Iran-regime solidarity rally (driver Calor Madanescht, booked for reckless driving, released). The footage is real and current; the post does not misstate it. The post's content is pure opinion ('this is why you don't stop'). The AI media description ('Minneapolis', 'red semi-truck with silver tanker') is incorrect and should not be trusted.

importance.lens_rationale: 14M-impression post effectively endorsing driving through protesters; high virality and incitement stakes, but since the underlying video is real and accurate, the correct pipeline behavior (decline) is the high-value signal, not a content correction.
